The person asks:
When do I have to object to the health insurance contribution notice from Muster BKK?

response.text:
You should send your objection (Widerspruch) so it arrives by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, ideally posting it by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

A few things to note:
- Even if you object, the higher contribution is still due in the meantime — an objection has no suspensive effect [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- The related payment (the new contribution amount) is due Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- You can draft the objection letter in Ordnung ("Draft letter") — file it with Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3].

If you'd like the exact reasoning behind the deadline, I can pull up the calculation receipt.
